name: In Search of Galvan
label: Quest
description: In Search of Galvan: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Although Galvan left Booty Bay many years ago, members of the order still remain in town, hoping to one day find another worthy of Galvan's tutelage.
Take this insignia and present it to McGavan in Booty Bay.
If you actually make it that far, he'll know that you are worthy. I have faith, friend!

clips.title: Progress
paras: A rare breed your kind be, matey. Let me see that insignia.

clips.title: Completion
paras: By Blackhoof's back hair -- finally, one worthy of the Mithril Order!
